automatedComment.message: This performs a nested scan over all sessions and chats for every GitHub telemetry notification. If these notifications are frequent, this can become a hot path. Consider maintaining an index from sdkSessionId → chat (or → AgentHostClientType) that is updated when chat sessions are created/disposed and/or when turns start/reset; then telemetry routing becomes O(1) lookup.

automatedComment.message: The initialize-on-reconnect-fallback path duplicates a large chunk of ‘apply initialize result’ logic (server seq, defaultDirectory parsing, and many _update* calls). To reduce drift risk (future config knobs, result fields, etc.), factor this into a shared helper used by both the initial initialize handshake and this fallback, so any changes remain consistent.
